item_text: Purpose: The presentation clearly establishes a purpose and a central idea.
item_description: Ranges from unclear or missing purpose to a clear and compelling central idea that effectively guides the presentation.

item_text: Content: The content is accurate, well-organized, and supported with relevant evidence.
item_description: Ranges from confusing content with factual errors and weak support to fully accurate content with clear subject definition and strong supporting evidence.

item_text: Comprehension: The presenter demonstrates understanding of the topic and responds effectively to questions.
item_description: Ranges from limited understanding with incorrect responses to complete understanding with accurate and confident answers.

item_text: Presentation: The presentation is delivered confidently with clear speech, appropriate body language, and good engagement.
item_description: Ranges from nervous and unclear delivery with poor engagement to confident, clear, and engaging delivery with effective use of body language and voice.

item_text: Visual Aids: The visual aids are clear, relevant, and enhance the presentation.
item_description: Ranges from ineffective and cluttered visuals to high-quality, clear, and well-structured visuals that support understanding.

item_text: Length: The presentation duration is appropriate and meets the required time limit.
item_description: Ranges from significantly under or over time to fully meeting the required time limit.

item_text: Creativity: The presentation demonstrates creativity and effectively engages the audience.
item_description: Ranges from no creativity and low engagement to highly creative, compelling delivery that enhances audience understanding and interest.
